hey mixed couples, question about couples that spend too much time abroad
I want my gf to be able to come visit israel frequently and sometimes stay for a bit without going through nightmares at the airport

we obviously know about the partner visa process, but from our understanding it mostly works for couples that know they want to live and stay in israel, we don’t 

most of the year we spend abroad but we still want to have the ability to come here freely

is there a different track from the partner visa that works better for that?
